note: Primary: STATIC-MATCHED vs ADAPTIVE. Secondary: STATIC-LARGE vs ADAPTIVE. Tertiary: INVERTED-ADAPTIVE vs ADAPTIVE (mechanism test).

primary_test_matched_vs_adaptive.caution: Significance without practical effect: do not label as improvement.
